executive_summary: One calendar-only variance hypothesis, locked before any R17 forecast score. Exact safe source is unchanged. Exposed history cannot establish independent alpha.
hypothesis: A preannounced FOMC release inside a target window adds uncertainty beyond the frozen V5.1 price-history distribution. No direction, decision, surprise, convergence or future return enters the feature.
asof_clock: 17:00 America/New_York on each specified Monday; all market observations from ALFRED vintage of previous calendar day, further truncated strictly before origin date. Date-level vintage does not justify intraday current-day access.
market_vintage_requirement: Each CSV header must exactly match all requested previous-day vintage dates; latest-vintage mixed responses are rejected. No API key. No forward fill of training/evaluation targets.
calendar_feature: N_h=count of original preannounced expected release instants in (origin 17:00 NY, origin+BDay(h) 17:00 NY], subject to schedule available_at<=origin; x_h=N_h/h. Monday-Friday business days; missing target quotes are blocked, never imputed.
feature_formula: candidate_d,a,h=mu_a,h+sqrt(1+beta*x_h)*(baseline_d,a,h-mu_a,h). If N_h=0 return exact baseline bytes/values without arithmetic. Location unchanged.
parameter_fit: One global beta=clip(sum_train x_h*((y_a,h-mu_a,h)^2/v_a,h-1)/sum_train x_h^2,0,4), over complete primary 3x3 grids only. v=population variance of 1000 frozen baseline draws. Fit data must mature by 2023-12-31. beta not searched. Zero denominator blocks experiment.

target_source.purpose: exposed public historical market labels, never forecast inputs; date coverage only used to set origin endpoint

comparator.context: Controlled F3 abstention route with empty text, exact original CLI and Numeric V3; not old continuous cache and not a full Final text-corpus quality claim.
comparator.runtime_gate: 26 original package hashes equal prior image receipt; four representative original CLI fixture output value and parquet hashes must match archived safe Docker receipt before outcome evaluation. This is a host bridge, not a new Docker run.

metric.method: Import original current Track2 scoring._composite and tail; shared CRPS/variogram implementations, no copied/reimplemented score math.
metric.normalization: NOT_OFFICIAL_M0. Fixed per-component baseline mean raw loss on complete training primary/secondary grids; same divisor for both forecasts. Original scorer also reports raw components. Official M0 generator/scale artifacts are not public; do not call this leaderboard loss.
metric.pooling: Mean paired grid loss; primary complete 3x3 only. Primary single-cell/per-asset/per-horizon diagnostics are separate. Secondary complete available cells are reported, not used to select parameters.
metric.uncertainty: moving blocks of four consecutive primary evaluation origins, 1000 replications, fixed seed; report candidate/baseline mean-loss ratio 95% interval.

success_criterion.limitations: Even all checks passing only supports further validation; exposed history forbids Final promotion.

falsification_predeclared: One-business-day additional market input lag with same frozen beta and same target, paired lagged baseline; no refit
Calendar placebo shifted seven calendar days, same beta and baseline; diagnostics only
All primary per-asset, horizon, single-cell, quarter, event-exposed and non-event subsets
Leave one quarter out and remove largest-gain origin without subset reselection
Joint/tail adverse ratio checks and finite shape/mean/exact zero-event fallback/repeat determinism
Calendar source dates and market vintage header/cutoff audit; no calendar content outcomes
stop_rules: Required vintage/source bridge/scorer missing => performance NOT_RUN/BLOCKED; max two failures per operational step; partial downloads/logs kept; no alternative hypothesis after results.
